rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a pressable physical control or an on-screen control.

example.english: Press the button and the door will open.
example.traditional: 撳落個按鈕就可以開門喇。
example.jyutping: gam6 lok6 go3 on3 nau2 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 mun4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a physical electrical button or switch in everyday Hong Kong speech.

example.english: Remember to press the button before turning off the lights.
example.jyutping: sik1 dang1 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 gam6 zai3

rows.note: Use this for a clothing button that passes through a buttonhole.

example.english: This button came off, so the shirt won't fasten.
example.traditional: 呢粒鈕甩咗，件衫扣唔埋。
example.jyutping: ni1 lap1 nau2 lat1 zo2 gin6 saam1 kau3 m4 maai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a badge-style button pinned to clothing.

example.english: They pinned a button badge to their school uniform.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin6 haau6 fuk6 ding1 zo2 go3 gam1 zoeng1
